field.$description: Field — the wrapper every form control sits in (Radix Form.Field / shadcn FormItem): an optional label above, the control, a description under it and an error message under that. Added 2026-10-26 from the Storybook Form. The label above is only for controls without a floating label of their own — a group of checkboxes or radios, a date picker, a switch, Input sm. Input and Select base/lg keep their floating label (our language, not Storybook's label-above). The description stays when an error shows: it usually explains the rule the error is about. On error the control's border turns border.danger (Input's own error state) and the message appears with an error icon; the label stays text.default — a red border and a red message are enough, a red label only adds noise. Required is the norm and isn't marked; the rare optional field says '(optional)'.

label.$description: Same heading-sm the Checkbox and Radio group headings use.

labelGap.$description: 8px label → control, same as the group headings' labelGap.

optional.$description: '(optional)' after the label — quieter than the label itself.

messageGap.$description: 4px control → description and description → error: the messages read as part of the control above them, not as the next field.

description.$description: Same body-sm / text.secondary as the group helper text.

icon.$description: The error icon goes with the colour — status is never colour alone.
